dishes.name: Dinner Tonight: Red Lentil And Tofu Curry Recipe

steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Pour one tablespoon of the olive oil into a medium-sized saucepan set over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent and soft, about five minutes. Toss in ginger and cook until fragrant, about one minute. Then add lentils and the water. Turn heat to high and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat to low, and simmer until the lentils are soft, 15 to 20 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Meanwhile, dry tofu cubes on some paper towels. Place a large wok over medium heat. Add the cumin and cook until very fragrant, about one minute. Transfer to a bowl.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Pour the remaining one tablespoon of olive oil into the wok. When shimmering, add the tofu cubes. Stir-fry until lightly browned on most sides, about four minutes. Add the curry powder, cayenne pepper, and salt. Cook until very fragrant, one to two minutes, and then transfer contents to saucepan with lentils.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Let the lentils and tofu cook over medium heat for five minutes. Serve curry with rice and garnish with cilantro.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In an 11- by 17-inch roasting pan, mix vegetables, oil, and tandoori masala.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Bake in a 400° oven, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are browned and tender when pierced, 40 to 45 minutes (30 to 35 minutes in a convection oven).'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Transfer to serving dish. Serve hot or cool. Cover and chill up to 1 day. Add salt and pepper to taste.'}

steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': "Pour the oil into a large skillet set over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook until it is reddish brown, about a minute or so. Stir often. Make sure it doesn't burn. If it does, then start over."}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add the potatoes, tomatoes, garam masala, salt and turmeric. Turn heat down to medium. Stir occasionally, and cook for about 10 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Pour in a cup of water. Scrap the pan with a wooden spoon, dislodging any browned bits. When the mixture comes to a boil, cover the skillet, reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the potatoes and tomatoes are tender. Stir every few minutes or so.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'You want the final sauce to be kind of thick, so mash up a few of the potatoes and tomatoes with the wooden spoon. Turn off the heat, stir in the cilantro, and serve.'}

{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place the cumin seeds and mustard seeds in the hot oil. Cook and stir until the seeds begin to pop. Mix in the peas and cauliflower. Season with salt. Reduce heat to low, cover, and continue cooking 15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.'}

dishes.name: Dinner Tonight: Baingan Bharta (Eggplant Curry) Recipe

steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Preheat the broiler. Rub a little bit of the oil on the eggplant and set underneath the broiler. Cook until flesh is very tender, flipping every 3 to 4 minutes, about 8 to 10 minutes total. Remove and set aside to cool down.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Pour the rest of the oil into a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the cumin and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Toss in the ginger and chilies, and cook for a minute, stirring constantly. Add the onions and cook until translucent, about 5 to 7 minutes. Dump in the tomatoes and cook for 5 to 7 minutes more.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Remove the skin from the cooled down eggplant, and roughly chop the tender flesh. Add to the skillet along with the red chili powder, garam masala, tumeric, and the rest of the cumin. Cook for 5 minutes so all the flavors can mingle. Season to taste with salt and garnish with some cilantro.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Place potatoes, carrots and green beans in the cold water. Allow to soak while you prepare the rest of the vegetables; drain.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'In a microwave safe dish place the potatoes, carrots, green beans, peas, salt and turmeric. Cook for 8 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook mustard seeds and cumin; when seeds start to sputter and pop, add the onion and saute until transparent. Stir in the tomatoes, garam masala, ginger, garlic and chili powder; saute 3 minutes. Add the cooked vegetables to the tomato mixture and saute 1 minute. Garnish with cilantro leaves.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Heat half the oil in large saucepan on high heat. Cook chicken for 4-5 mins, until browned. Transfer to a plate.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat remaining oil in same pan on high heat. Saute onion and garlic for 4-5 mins, until onion is tender. Add spices and bay leaf. Cook, stirring, for 1 min until fragrant.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Stir in stock and lentils. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer for 10-15 mins, until lentils are tender.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir in coconut milk and lemon juice. Season to taste. Top with cilantro. Serve with pappadums.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Core the cabbage and slice into fine long shreds.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Preheat the oil over medium-high heat in a large heavy skillet.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'When hot add the cumin seeds and bay leaves, cooking for just a few seconds.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add the cabbage and peas, stirring to mix well.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Add the turmeric and cayenne, mixing well.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Cover and reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until vegetables are crisp-tender Add the chili, salt and sugar, stir to mix.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Cover and cook an additional 2 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Remove from heat, add the garam masala, stir gently to mix and serve.'}

{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Pour the oil into a large skillet set over medium-high heat. Toss in the onion, cayenne, turmeric, cumin, garam masala, a pinch of salt, and then reduce heat to medium. Cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, or until the onions are tender.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add the okra, still well, and cook for 15 minutes. Add the tomato and lemon juice, stir well, and cook for 5 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Sprinkle with the cilantro, season to taste with salt, and serve.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Mash together the cooked veggies, but not too much.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat the oil, add the cumin and chilli flakes. Once sizzling, add the veggie mix with the spices and press down firmly to brown the underside.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine breast halves, onion, garlic, red pepper and water in large Dutch oven.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Bring to boil.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Cover; reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes or until tender.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Remove breast halves from broth. Skim fat from broth.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Bone chicken.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Cut into bite-size pieces. Combine broth, chicken, chopped vegetables and remaining ingredients in pan.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Bring to boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Yield:'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': '9 cups.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Peel and dice eggplant.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in heavy frypan and saute garlic 3 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Remove garlic.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add onion, green pepper and eggplant and cook 3 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Add tomatoes and salt.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Cook slowly over low fire 20 minutes until eggplant is tender.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In a soup kettle, simmer onions and garlic in oil and water until transparent.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add potatoes and carrots and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add tomatoes and cumin. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Check occasionally to see if more liquid is needed. If so, add tomato juice as needed.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add green beans and cook 15 minutes more.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Check seasoning and add pepper and more cumin to taste.'}
{'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Prepare a bowl of ice water.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Cut brussels sprouts into halves and remove loose leaves.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Bring pot of water to boil, add brussels sprouts, adding the larger brussels sprouts to water first. Blanch in hot water for just about 10 seconds .'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir the boiling water and sprouts, then immediately drain brussels sprouts and add to prepared ice bath. When cooled, remove brussel sprouts and place on paper towels to dry.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Heat pan , add the oil.when oil is heated add minced garlic and shallots and fry until brown. Add brussels sprouts,to the mix and toss.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Add soy sauce, salt and curry powder. Toss brussels in pan very well and cook quite quickly, but only about 1 minute . Do not overcook!'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Remove from heat, add the cream toss and put back on the heat for about 30 seconds and toss again.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Serve hot.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat the oil, add the cumin and chilli flakes. Once sizzling, add the veggie mix with the spices and press down firmly to brown the underside.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.'}

dishes.name: Curried Chicken-Vegetable Stew
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine breast halves, onion, garlic, red pepper and water in large Dutch oven.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Bring to boil.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Cover; reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes or until tender.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Remove breast halves from broth. Skim fat from broth.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Bone chicken.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Cut into bite-size pieces. Combine broth, chicken, chopped vegetables and remaining ingredients in pan.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Bring to boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Yield:'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': '9 cups.'}

dishes.name: Eggplant "Turkish Style"
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Peel and dice eggplant.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in heavy frypan and saute garlic 3 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Remove garlic.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add onion, green pepper and eggplant and cook 3 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Add tomatoes and salt.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Cook slowly over low fire 20 minutes until eggplant is tender.'}

dishes.name: Vegetarian Moroccan Stew
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In a soup kettle, simmer onions and garlic in oil and water until transparent.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add potatoes and carrots and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add tomatoes and cumin. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Check occasionally to see if more liquid is needed. If so, add tomato juice as needed.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add green beans and cook 15 minutes more.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Check seasoning and add pepper and more cumin to taste.'}

dishes.name: Brussels Sprouts & Curry
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Prepare a bowl of ice water.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Cut brussels sprouts into halves and remove loose leaves.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Bring pot of water to boil, add brussels sprouts, adding the larger brussels sprouts to water first. Blanch in hot water for just about 10 seconds .'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir the boiling water and sprouts, then immediately drain brussels sprouts and add to prepared ice bath. When cooled, remove brussel sprouts and place on paper towels to dry.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Heat pan , add the oil.when oil is heated add minced garlic and shallots and fry until brown. Add brussels sprouts,to the mix and toss.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Add soy sauce, salt and curry powder. Toss brussels in pan very well and cook quite quickly, but only about 1 minute . Do not overcook!'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Remove from heat, add the cream toss and put back on the heat for about 30 seconds and toss again.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Serve hot.'}
